Keep private launch gates and parked dispositions unchanged; do not create telemetry, deploy, spend, requeue, or conduct external outreach.

Owner concern: 39 improvements await measurement, 8 requests failed, only 2 outcomes are proven, and operations/security evidence is unavailable.
